beats.say: The documentary film You Can See Everything raked in $15 million on its box office debut.
According to the BBC, the film was co-directed by Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim.
Actress Amanda Seyfried appears in the hybrid documentary to re-enact events.
The film premiered as a secret screening at the 53rd Telluride Film Festival on 6 September 2026.
The BBC says You Can See Everything will be released in UK cinemas from 20 November.
Will you be watching You Can See Everything in UK cinemas on 20 November?
